title: Perfect matchings of $K_{n,n}$
statement: For every natural number $n$, the complete bipartite graph $K_{n,n}$, whose two vertex classes each have $n$ vertices and whose edges are exactly the pairs joining a vertex of one class to a vertex of the other, has exactly $n!$ perfect matchings.
hypotheses_covered: graph is the complete bipartite graph on two n-element classes
replaced:
Ex 5.1.1(b): number of perfect matchings of \texttt{K\_\{n,n\}} is \texttt{n!}.

(b) Find the number of different perfect matchings in $K_{2n}$ and $K_{n,n}$.
